workType: Upper-volume reconstruction and facade opening correction; inherited podium and ground-level collision retained

source.publication: 2024 EPNF, photos and plans credited 2023; aerial credited Nearmap 2022

evidence.use: Aerial orientation and western low terrace; establishes reversal of the north-down roof drawing relative to world east.
Existing tan brick, narrow end windows, long vertical window bands and dark spandrels.
Existing upper envelopes in the renovation roof plan; trace tower proportions and positions within unchanged podium, not proposed equipment.
Check rectangular narrow/deep tower proportion; proposed interior room rearrangements are not modeled.
Explicit description of original tan brick, concrete shelves/fins, dark spandrels and aluminium windows. Proposed metal cladding is excluded.

source.rights: Published architectural reference used for local study. No photograph or drawing is embedded into game materials; no claim of permission to redistribute source imagery as a game asset.

oldModelProblems: 29 m wide / 20.62 m deep towers reversed the characteristic narrow end and long side relationship.
Three towers were placed symmetrically on the entire podium, ignoring the larger western low terrace.
All four faces used the same small horizontal repeated windows instead of narrow central end bands and multiple long-side vertical bands.

parameters.trace: Roof image width x105..1532, A/B/C centres approximately x332.5,727,1119.5; map-image horizontal reversal confirmed against Figure 1-2.
parameters.precision: Photo/plan trace fitted to retained Boston GIS podium; not surveyed construction dimensions. Frame, shelf and reveal sections are visual estimates.

preserved: Boston GIS podium footprint and position
Existing base height and 60.2 m roof datum
Retail openings, entrance and curved canopy
Road, sidewalk and closed ground-level wall collision

mobile.geometry: Same corrected tower volumes, real wall openings, recesses and concrete shelves; small inner sash members become planes.
mobile.reasonForIncrease: Retain actual depth and facade structure instead of the former planar mobile windows; whole-campus export and real mobile-emulation checks are recorded in the round delivery.

limitations: This reconstructs the pre-renovation exterior documented in 2022-2023, not an assertion about the completion state of the 2024 renovation proposal in October 2026.
Exact frame profiles, repaired glass-block strips, local material wear and roof plant remain approximate.
The inherited podium storey structure and site curb setback still require further real-scene calibration.

validation.technical: 25 focused tests passed, including actual raycasts through recessed windows and onto adjacent solid brick, unchanged collision perimeter, tower/gap roof checks and bounded mobile detail.
validation.visual: 已检查固定机位前后对照、三塔街景及完整游戏步行近景；形体类别修正成立，材质/基座和全部方向仍未完成真实感验收。详见 realism-corrections-20261026.json。
